review_notes: The file has one theorem, `bundleMapClass_comp_left`. It says that left composition with a bundle-map class equals `ofFragment` of a relabelled fragment. It is a computation lemma about an existing operation (`HomSpace.comp`), not a function whose homomorphism, continuity, equivalence or action structure is left as separate facts. I searched the RegtsSevenster sources for `bundleMapCompose`, `bundleMapClass` and `ofFragment_congr`. I did not find a standard bundle that this file leaves unexposed, or an existing consumer that a new bundle would clarify. Any bundling here, for example a `bundleMapClass` action of equivalences on classes, would be speculative. I did not read the full definition of `bundleMapClass`, so I cannot rule out that such a bundle is justified elsewhere.
